# Sapal Yonghang

> Events and hospitality professional with an MSc in International Event Management (Pass with Commendation). Three years of experience across the UAE and UK, from the Dubai World Cup for 3,000+ attendees to multi-day conferences in Belfast.

Based in Kathmandu, Nepal. This is the personal portfolio website of Sapal Yonghang, an event management professional.

## About
- Role: Events and Hospitality Professional
- Focus: MICE and spectator events, live event support, guest registration, venue setup, supplier liaison and guest service
- Languages: English (fluent), Hindi (fluent)

## Experience
- Meydan Hotels & Hospitality, Dubai (May 2018 – Feb 2021): Waiter, Conference & Events. Large-scale corporate and spectator events including the Dubai World Cup (3,000+ attendees), Sensation Dubai and Red Bull Car Drift Dubai.
- Gastronomy Summit, Ulster University, Belfast (Apr 2022): Event Assistant. Speaker check-in and session coordination.
- CABS Annual Conference, Belfast (May 2022): Conference Assistant. Registered and checked in 200+ delegates.
- Himalayan Nepalese and Indian Restaurant, Belfast (Jan 2022 – May 2023): Waiter.
- Lansia Ltd, London (Jun 2023 – Oct 2025): Crew Member.

## Education
- MSc International Event Management, Ulster University, Belfast (2022 – 2023): Pass with Commendation.
- Higher Diploma in Hotel Management, Fachhochschule Salzburg University of Applied Sciences, delivered in Kathmandu, Nepal (2013 – 2017): With merit.
- Google Foundations of Project Management, Coursera (Oct 2025).

## Case Study
Four short observation pieces on events: Beyond the Crowd, Behind the Event, Events of Tomorrow, and Event Tourism and Local Economic Impact. Abstracts are on the website; full pieces are shared on request.
